# elemento_filestorage (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the NFS export is reachable from the public internet.
- `name` (String) Name of the file storage.
- `region` (String) Region to deploy in. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `size_gb` (Number) Provisioned size in GB.

### Optional

- `billing_frequency` (String) Billing period, e.g. `day`, `month` or `year`. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `billing_uuid` (String) Portal billing UUID.
- `creation_date` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `creator_uuid` (String) UUID of the account that created the resource.
- `dns_name` (String) DNS name of the NFS server.
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp of the last update.
- `mount_command` (String) Command that mounts the share.
- `nfs_host` (String) NFS server host.
- `nfs_path` (String) Exported NFS path.
- `nfs_version` (String) NFS protocol version.
- `payment_url` (String) URL where the payment for the resource is completed.
- `state` (String) Current state reported by the service.
- `status` (String) Current status of the resource.
- `used_gb` (Number) Space currently used, in GB.
- `uuid` (String) Service UUID.
